svg.aria-label: cad-agent: Gyropup's five-bar leg drawn from its real CAD, assembled, then checked for fit, strength and motion
svg.title: cad-agent: Gyropup's five-bar leg drawn from its real CAD, assembled, then checked for fit, strength and motion
svg.desc: The leg's edges draw in from its STEP file with hidden lines removed, its parts slide together along the motor axes, a scan checks the clearance between the moving parts, the hip frame fills with stress from Gyropup's own FEA, and the five-bar steps through a stride solved from its real link lengths. It ends on the cad-agent wordmark with the three checks passed. Geometry and results from github.com/Valpatel/gyropup (MIT).
svg.text: Gyropup's leg, drawn from its STEP file

g.text: no clash in 12 poses · passing parts ≥ 7.3 mm apart
FEA hip frame: 13.9 MPa, fails at 1.65× load
five-bar stride · knees ≥ 60° from a dead point
